summary: Testing of Live Tickets Monitoring and Super Admin Cancel features complete. All backend APIs pass 100% (11/11 tests). Frontend tests confirm: Dashboard shows 'En Vivo' menu with pulse icon, Live Tickets page loads with stats bar, EN VIVO indicator, NUEVO badges, and Cancel buttons for pending tickets.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/monitoring/live-tickets (lines 1830-1879) correctly returns tickets and stats with total_today, total_sales, pending, won, cancelled
Backend /api/admin/seller-profile/{seller_id} (lines 1881-1927) returns seller info with today_stats and recent activity
Backend cancel_ticket (lines 1338-1399) correctly checks is_super_admin before applying time limit - Super Admin bypasses 5-minute rule
Frontend tickets.tsx canCancel function (lines 104-115) correctly returns true for super_admin role without time check
Frontend live-tickets.tsx correctly implements auto-refresh every 5 seconds with pause/play toggle
Frontend live-tickets.tsx shows 'NUEVO' badge for first 3 tickets and Cancel button for pending tickets when user is super_admin
seed_data_creation: Used existing test data - 83 tickets with 13 pending
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live Tickets Monitoring feature fully implemented. GET /api/monitoring/live-tickets returns tickets with stats (total_today, total_sales, pending, won, cancelled). GET /api/admin/seller-profile/{seller_id} returns full seller profile. Super Admin can cancel ANY pending ticket at ANY time (no 5-minute limit). Dashboard shows 'En Vivo' menu with pulse icon linking to /live-tickets page.
